business.description: The Company is engaged in manufacturing and sale of Jute products. It operates a composite Jute Mill at Budge Budge, West Bengal, and a specialty weaving unit at Falta Special Economic Zone, West Bengal, producing conventional jute products (sacking bags, hessian fabrics, industrial yarns) and value-added offerings (fine fabrics for premium shopping bags, certified food-grade packaging, technical textiles for flooring and erosion control).

outlook.statement: The Company's performance during the current year will depend largely on the extent of availability of the raw jute crop. Albeit, we expect a much better crop compared to the previous season. However, the year is likely to remain challenging, particularly during the months of July and August, when uncertainty regarding raw jute availability may persist. Other income remains uncertain, as it may be influenced by the outcome of West Asia conflict. However, we believe that the overall outlook for the current year would be stable.
The Company expects to contribute ₹ NIL to its gratuity fund in F.Y. 2026-27.

capex_plans.item: Installation of a rooftop Solar Power Plant with a capacity of 2,274.48 kWp (contributes to approximately 12-15 percent of the power requirement) and purchase of machineries required for strengthening manufacturing efficiency

risks: High raw jute prices and wage costs challenge cost control to retain markets
No significant modernisation under process; modernisation essential for improving efficiency and remaining economical
Increased global focus on ethanol production (due to West Asia conflict) may raise maize prices, encouraging farmers to shift from raw jute to maize cultivation
Domestic and export markets may shift to alternative packaging materials due to high jute product prices and supply uncertainties
Labour-intensive industry facing steep revision in minimum wages and shortage of workers as labourers find opportunities closer to home regions
West Asia conflict and tariff-related issues adversely impacting export demand
Uncertainty in other income due to global market conditions influenced by West Asia conflict
foreign exchange exposure on exports and imports
